text: A top-down field of square cells with a drawn grid; a click puts the selected block into a cell, a right-click takes it out.

Two or three block kinds on one row, picked by number keys; a click places the selected kind, a right-click takes a block back out, and each block sits on a tidy grid with a count of the kinds in use.
A 32 by 32 base where each click adds one block to the column under the pointer, up to a height cap, and a right-click takes the top block back down.
Press and drag across the grid to lay blocks along the path, one per cell crossed; a right-click drag takes them back out, and a short pause shows the stroke's end.
A translucent preview of the chosen block sits on the empty cell under the pointer; a click places it, a right-click removes a placed block, and a line of text names that cell's column and row.
